043package dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate;
044
045import javax.sql.RowSet;
046import javax.sql.RowSetEvent;
047
048/**
049 * Actions for working with {@link RowSet}s; used with
050 * {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsActions}.
051 */
052// TODO: RowsAction not RowsAction???
053public enum RowsAction {
054  /** Go to first record. */
055  ACT_FIRST,
056  /** Go to last record. */
057  ACT_LAST,
058  /** Go to next record. */
059  ACT_NEXT,
060  /** Go to previous record. */
061  ACT_PREVIOUS,
062  /** Commit current record to data base. */
063  ACT_COMMIT,
064  /** Undo changes to current record. */
065  ACT_REVERT,
066  /** Refresh record. */
067  ACT_REFRESH,
068  /** Add record. */
069  ACT_ADD(true), // This action has no associated RowSet event.
070  /** Delete record. */
071  ACT_DELETE,
072  /**
073   * A specialized action for "goto row number".
074   * This action has a Property, see {@link javax.swing.Action#getValue(java.lang.String)},
075   * NavigateActions.KEY_SPINNER_MODEL, whose value is a
076   * {@link javax.swing.SpinnerNumberModel} which models the ResultSet's current row.
077   */
078  ACT_GOTOROW,
079  /** Need with CachedRowSet since no RowSet events */
080  ACT_REVERT_FORCE(true, true),
081  /** Send a row changed rowSet event */
082  ACT_ROW_SET_EVENT(true, true),
083  ;
084
085  /**
086   * Enumeration for navigation buttons.
087   */
088  public enum Navigation {
089    /** Go to the first record in the RowSet */
090    First(3),
091    /** Go to the last record in the RowSet */
092    Last(4),
093    /** Go to the next record in the RowSet */
094    Next(1),
095    /** Go to the previous record in the RowSet */
096    Previous(2);
097
098    private final int value;
099
100    Navigation(int newValue) {
101      value = newValue;
102    }
103
104    /**
105     * @return integer corresponding to enumerated value
106     */
107    public int getValue() {
108      return value;
109    }
110  }
111
112  private final boolean force;
113  private final boolean virtual;
114
115  private RowsAction() {
116    this(false, false);
117  }
118
119  private RowsAction(boolean force) {
120    this(force, false);
121  }
122
123  private RowsAction(boolean force, boolean virtual) {
124    this.force = force;
125    this.virtual = virtual;
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Flag means to create a {@link RowsEvent} for this {@code RowsAction}
130   * even if there is no associated {@link RowSetEvent}.
131   *
132   * @return true means unconditionally create event
133   */
134  public boolean isForce() {
135    return force;
136  }
137
138  /**
139   * Not a real event.
140   * @return true means don't try to instantiate it
141   */
142  public boolean isVirtual() {
143    return virtual;
144  }
145
146  /**
147   * Following could be used by spinner as event's command to indicate that if
148   * already on the row don't need to do "rs.absolute()".
149   * But that might be the default behavior anyway, in which case this would
150   * be a no-op.
151   */
152  public static final String OK_SKIP_CURSOR_MOVE = "MAY_SKIP_GOTOROW";
153}
